reasoning: This is a generic circled left arrow used as 'back' or 'previous' interface navigation chrome. Because it depicts an abstract direction rather than a concrete subject, almost any real-world task (returning a package, reverting code, booking a return flight) is much better served by a specific object icon (a box, git branch, train, or curved undo arrow).
